text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*... Dammit— It's not 
enough... Not nearly enough yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Bambi! You're still running? It's 
practically midnight, don'tcha know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw... ain't your mood kinda down? You 
good?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's get hyped together with me! 
Woo-hoo~~☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
! ...Got it! I gotta get more hyped up and 
give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for getting me fired up...! I'm 
going in for one more lap...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? ...Oh crap, did I just mess 
up~~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huuuuurrrrppp!!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'll have to work even harder, 
huh... Hehe, that's so like Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup! But this is totally a blunder, 
right?! Like, totally, utterly, completely 
counterproductive, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I actually meant get hyped? Relax? Hit 
reset kinda vibe, but~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, I don't get it...!! How am I 
supposed to get the point across?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's true... If cheerful encouragement 
only makes her push herself harder, then—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How about telling them quietly, without 
any rush? For example...
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "...Bam-cham!! Good work!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Sup. What'd you call me for? If you're in 
trouble, I can help out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!? Then today we—wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This is for you, Bambi-cham! A present for 
yooouu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? A letter?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Banchamu! Sorry about messing up the 
other day!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Y'know, I noticed Bambam seemed down. 
Thought she might be pushing herself, 
y'know? Wanted to cheer her up, so I 
called out to her!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So I went all-out, right? And then 
Bam-cham went all-out too, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"That was a bad idea! What I really want 
is for you to rest and get hyped! I want 
you to stay healthy!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Did it reach ya? Hope it did! From 
Helipiyo, who loves Bam-cham to bits♡"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what was going on. You 
were worried about me... Sorry for not 
getting it sooner.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, you did nothing wrong, Banchamu! I 
mean... did you get what I meant?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! Got the message loud and clear! 
Plus—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Wuv you so much Banchamu ♡ From Heli-pi" 
...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that hit the spot for you? Waha! 
That makes me so happy!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll be careful for now! If I feel like 
going all out, I'll write a letter first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Sup! If I get to read another letter, I'm 
super hyped!

And so, Daitaku Helios learned a new way 
of doing things: how to quietly be there 
by someone's side.
